system.description:
FOCUS MOVE TECHNIQUE Action 2 AP

You flood your body with controlled momentum, allowing you to leap impossible distances for 1 minute. You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Land Speed, but at the end of each of your turns you must be standing on a surface capable of supporting you or you fall.

GREATER MASTERY At 9th level, at the end of your turn you may attempt a DC 25 Acrobatics check to remain in the air. On a success, you do not fall that turn.

Automated: press Use: 2 AP and this use. You gain a Fly Speed equal to your land Speed for 1 minute; from 9th level the card reminds you of the DC 25 Acrobatics check. Not automated: end each turn on a surface (or, from 9th, roll that check) or use the Falling action.
